verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own official SDKs for Python and JavaScript/Node, including a versioned SDK (11.0.0) that auto-instruments popular AI SDKs, and its site tells users to drop in the SDK. AI coding agents can set the SDK up automatically, and a community user reports native integration was very simple. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of the full SDK and platform set in the pack, and SDK API reference depth beyond the AI-agents module.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Drop in the [SDK](https://sentry.io/platforms/). No agents to install.
As of SDK version `11.0.0`, Sentry auto-instruments the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks out of the box
Your agent will set up Sentry in your Python app automatically. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and more.
Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
